metadata.description: Public, audited Agent Skills. Each skill here passed a sanitization + readiness audit before publishing.

plugins.name: browser-ai-bridge
plugins.description: Walk through your app with an AI helper in a real browser you can watch. It reads the live page and actually clicks, types, and edits it while you talk — not just looking, and not hidden. Use to test your own web app, reproduce a bug, or get guided help walking through a UI.

plugins.name: firecrawl-search
plugins.description: Make Firecrawl the web search for a chat, and get set up with it: no-account trial, free key, or sign-in, plus what the free credits cover and what to do when they run out.

plugins.name: job-search-copilot
plugins.description: A careful job-hunt helper. Writes resumes and cover letters in your voice, explains every field on an application, and fills forms in the browser for your review — never submitting on its own. Use to prepare job applications, understand a posting's fields, or get guided help filling one out. Bring your own writing and details.

plugins.name: conductor
plugins.description: Run this chat as the planner on a strong model and hand the work to the cheapest helper that can do it well: Haiku to search and read, Sonnet to build what is already decided, Opus for the hard parts and review.

plugins.name: playwright-browser-bridge
plugins.description: A shared browser helper that other skills build on. It joins a browser you already have open instead of launching a new one, re-checks buttons before clicking, and deletes anything it downloads. Use as the browser layer under skills that read or act on web pages, like job-search-copilot and browser-ai-bridge.

plugins.name: token-saver
plugins.description: Cuts token spend with three rules: read passages not files, count every call in the job, never retry a usage-limit failure. Use when a session gets expensive or before adopting an efficiency skill.

plugins.name: walkthrough-video
plugins.description: Make a captioned how-to video of any web app from one JSON script: real screens recorded in headless Chrome, with title cards and captions rendered around them. Re-run it after the app changes for a fresh video.

plugins.name: scrappy-video-understanding
plugins.description: Scrappy progressive multi-pass video understanding: accepts any link or media file, extracts metadata, keyframes, contact sheets, subtitles, and audio.

plugins.name: astrohuh
plugins.description: Something in Astrolabe made you go huh? Point at it, and AstroHuh drafts a GitHub issue for Dan and Danny to read, with one approval to file.

plugins.name: forge
plugins.description: Turn something you keep doing by hand into a skill with its own button. Forge skims your open Astrolabe chats, offers about 3 ideas, and makes the one you pick.
